NSS  VGEC
NARAYANI
26th March to 29th March 2023

title: NARAYANI - Spreading Awareness
content:
Under India's G-20 presidency, many institutions are organizing various events based on different themes.
The National Service Scheme (NSS) unit of Vishwakarma Government Engineering College organized "NARAYANI" from 26th March to 29th March 2023.
The main motto was to spread awareness about women’s rights and gender equality.
Various Competitions like poem writing, rangoli making, quiz, debate, elocution, etc. were involved.
Students from across the state supported the event as participants.
We successfully completed our motive to spread awareness.

title: DAY - 1
sub_heading:
Nukkad Natak - Encouraging Women's Empowerment
More than 60 volunteers involved in a street play. 
The purpose of drama was to encourage women’s empowerment. 
Volunteers showed problems like dowry, rapping, etc.
They highlighted the fewer opportunities for women.

title: Quiz and Poem Competition Details
content:
Participants wrote poems on given topics.
Quiz questions covered women entrepreneurs, G-20, and women empowerment awareness.
Quiz helped participants gain general knowledge.
Poem writing improved writing skills.

Key Discussion Points:
* Improvement in writing skills and mental ability.
* Quiz completion enhances overall participation and general knowledge.

title: Debate and Rangoli Competition Details
content:
Rangoli competition showcased hands-free skills on colors with the theme of women empowerment.
The debate focused on women’s empowerment and gender equality.
Debate highlighted the current scenario of women’s empowerment in India.

Key Discussion Points:
* Colors are joyous, they teach us to be happy, and so does rangoli.
* Debate helped understand the problems of women and solutions.
* These competitions aided participant's overall development.

title: DAY - 4: Event Narayani Concludes
content:
The event "NARAYANI" concluded with the Elocution competition and the Ending ceremony.

In the Elocution competition, participants delivered speeches on topics aimed at raising awareness and support for women's empowerment.

Students showed great enthusiasm and delivered their best.

During the Ending ceremony, winners were awarded certificates and prizes. Faculties who contributed to the event "NARAYANI" by judging the competitions were also acknowledged with thank you gifts.

The event "NARAYANI" concluded with the National Anthem.

title: Key Discussion Points of the Event
content:
The Elocution competition enhanced people's understanding of the concepts related to women's empowerment.

The event highlighted that supporting women's choices and amplifying their voices is an ongoing process that deserves recognition and attention from everyone.

Ultimately, the event celebrated the efforts of all women and encouraged their continued strength and determination.
